sentence_stem: Had the council consulted local residents earlier,
correct_completion: the project would not have been abandoned.
full_sentence: Had the council consulted local residents earlier, the project would not have been abandoned.
acceptable_variants: the plans would have been revised in time.

options.text: the project is being abandoned now.
options.why_wrong: The present tense conflicts with the past-conditional structure set up by 'had consulted'.

options.text: they will abandon the project soon.
options.why_wrong: A future-tense main clause does not match the inverted third conditional opened by 'had consulted'.

options.text: the project would not have been abandoned.

options.why_wrong: A simple past reports a fact and does not complete the hypothetical result that the conditional clause introduces.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional (had + subject + past participle, with a perfect conditional in the main clause)
explanation: Inversion replaces 'if' with 'had' at the start of the clause, so the main clause must use a perfect conditional to describe a past hypothetical result. Learners often mix in present or future forms here, which breaks the time reference of the sentence.
translation: Se o conselho tivesse consultado os moradores locais mais cedo, o projeto não teria sido abandonado.
